script.text: After Devack was defeated in the shadow duel, Greiger appeared as the new Dark Signer.
He set out to battle Yusei, but he found one of Yusei's old friends instead.
Sorry pal, but you're not going anywhere!
Well, you found Crow. And you’re not going anywhere until we duel!
You’re challenging me? Get real. You’re not a Signer.
The only thing that matters is that you're a Dark Signer, and that means you're gonna pay for what you did!
Your giant monster and your freaky dark fog have taken everyone from Satellite.
Including the orphans I was taking care of.
They were just innocent kids! They didn’t do anything to you! But I guess that’s how you guys operate!
Well, not anymore, pal! I’m gonna stop you.
Since you’re so determined to destroy yourself, I’ll oblige you.
